project.title: LC-MS/MS identification of histone Kbz sites in yeast
project.projectDescription: Identification of 29 Kbz sites on yeast H3, H4, H2A, H2A.Z, and H2B by LC-MS/MS.
project.sampleProcessingProtocol: The histone samples were reductive alkylated, and then digested with trypsin (sample: trysin=1:50) pH 8-9. The peptides were desalinated and enriched by the anti-Kbz antibody conjugated beads, eluted by 0.15% TFA and analyzed by the LC-MS/MS.
project.dataProcessingProtocol: The benzoylation identification search was performed with the PEAKS Studio 8.5 against Uniprot Yeast protein database (6721 entries, http://www.uniprot.org).
